text_simplified: Disruptive mood dysregulation disorder (DMDD) is diagnosed in children between the ages of 6 and 10, and the symptoms must persist for at least 12 months. It includes symptoms such as severe, frequent temper outbursts and an irritable or angry mood most of the day, nearly every day.
